# 7-Reserve™ Costa Rica Coffee

Quality coffee from Costa Rica you can taste in every sip.

## Flavor Profile

## History of Costa Rica Coffee

Meet the robust flavor profile of this Costa Rican coffee bean. The first settlers brought coffee growing to the West Valley, where 25% of Costa Rica’s coffee production takes place. The West Valley produces a high quality bean because of its pleasant microclimate throughout the year with well-defined dry and rainy seasons. Costa Rica coffee beans are grown in volcanic soils and the slopes of the Western Central Mountain Range.

## About the Costa Rica Coffee

Why the West Valley? Our coffee comes from small, local farms in the Western Valley region, renowned for their exceptional Costa Rican coffee. Hacienda Candelaria and Beneficio Santa Eduviges are both family farms in Alajuela, West Valley that have been operating since the 1960s. We also get our coffee from Coop Libertad, which is a cooperative of small and medium coffee producers that grow high quality Costa Rican coffee 1200 meters above sea level in the West Valley region. Our rich coffee blend offers a complex variety of flavors due to the high altitude, stable climate and soil enriched with volcanic ash.

## Find the Coffee

Now that you know where the coffee in your cup is coming from, go try it for yourself! Our 7-Reserve™ Costa Rica coffee is only here for a short time. Grab the coffee from Costa Rica to go at your nearest 7-Eleven and enrich your daily commute. Pair it with a breakfast item to start your day.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## The Rich History of Colombian Coffee

If you really want to know about your Colombian coffee, you’ve got to go back in history to the 1700s when it arrived in the country with Jesuit priests who were among Spanish colonists. They’re responsible for planting the first trees which lead to the plants spreading across the country over the next century.
Initially commercial production was quite limited despite the climate, elevation, and rainfall being perfect for growing Arabica coffee. In 1927 all that began to change with the founding of Federación Nacional de Cafeteros de Colombia, providing support and extensive services to Colombian Farmers. As a result, the nation’s commercial coffee industry experienced a boom, resulting in Colombia becoming the third largest coffee producing nation in the world (after Brazil and Vietnam).
Today, thanks to the nation’s geography and various micro-climates, Colombia has 20 coffee producing regions producing 100% Arabica coffee featuring a wide range of unique flavor profiles.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## FAQs

  * ## [Button: What is The Tonight Dough ice cream?]

The Tonight Dough ice cream is caramel & chocolate ice creams with chocolate cookie swirls and gobs of chocolate chip cookie dough and peanut butter cookie dough.

  * ## [Button: Why is it called The Tonight Dough?]

The Tonight Dough ice cream was inspired by The Tonight Show, described by Ben & Jerry's as "the show & host we love staying up late for."

  * ## [Button: Does The Tonight Dough ice cream contain allergens, such as peanuts or gluten? ]

Yes. The Tonight Dough contains milk, egg, wheat, soy, and peanut ingredients. Additionally, the flavor contains wheat-based ingredients and is not considered gluten-free. People with food allergies should always check the product packaging for the most current ingredient and allergen information. 

  * ## [Button: Does buying The Tonight Dough ice cream support a charity?]

Yes. A portion of proceeds from The Tonight Dough ice cream goes to the SeriousFun Children's Network, which runs camps for children with serious illnesses.

  * ## [Button: Where can I get The Tonight Dough?]

The Tonight Dough is sold in pints at most major grocery stores and supermarkets, and it's also available at Ben & Jerry's Scoop Shops. You can check current stock near you and order online through Ben & Jerry’s grocery and delivery locator. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## FAQs

  * ## [Button: What is Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream? ]

Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream combines creamy vanilla ice cream with gobs of chocolate chip cookie dough for a flavor that tastes like eating cookie dough straight from the bowl.

  * ## [Button: Does Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream contain allergens?]

Yes. It contains milk, eggs, wheat and soy, so it's not suitable for anyone with allergies to those ingredients. Always review the package label for the latest ingredient information before consuming. 

  * ## [Button: When was Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream invented?]

Ben & Jerry's created the first chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream in 1984 at its original Scoop Shop in Burlington, Vermont, after an anonymous customer suggested mixing gobs of cookie dough into vanilla ice cream. It proved so popular that Ben & Jerry's started selling it in pints in 1991.

  * ## [Button: Is the cookie dough in Ben & Jerry’s Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough safe to eat? ]

Yes. The cookie dough is specifically produced for inclusion in ice cream and is intended to be eaten as part of the finished product. Want to go straight to the chunks? Ben & Jerry’s also has a line of snackable Cookie Dough Chunks. 

  * ## [Button: What formats is Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough available in, and is there a dairy-free option?]

Ben & Jerry’s Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough is available in several formats, including dairy pints, non-dairy pints, mini cups, ice cream bars, and by the scoop at Scoop Shops. The non-dairy version is made with an oat milk base instead of dairy, making it a suitable option for people avoiding milk or following a vegan diet.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Coffee Nutrition Facts (Black Coffee)

When enjoyed black, coffee is one of the lowest-calorie beverages available, with minimal macronutrients and small amounts of naturally occurring minerals.

## Standard Serving

8 fl oz (237 ml) brewed black coffee (arabica)

### Nutrition Breakdown

  * Calories: 2
  * Total Fat: 0g (0% DV)
  * Cholesterol: 0mg (0% DV)
  * Sodium: 0–2mg (0% DV)
  * Total Carbohydrates: 0g (0% DV)
  * Sugars: 0g
  * Protein: 0.3g

### Key Micronutrients

  * Potassium: ~100–120mg (2–3% DV)
  * Magnesium: ~7mg (2% DV)
  * B Vitamins: Trace amounts (notably Riboflavin/B2 and Niacin/B3)

*Percent Daily Values (DV) are based on a 2,000 calorie diet.

## What This Means

Black coffee delivers:

  * Virtually zero calories
  * No fat, sugar, or carbs
  * Small amounts of essential minerals

It’s a strong fit for low-calorie, low-carb, and fasting-friendly routines.

## Important Notes by Coffee Type

Not all coffee formats have identical nutrition profiles:

  * Espresso: More concentrated per ounce, but similar overall composition
  * Decaf Coffee: Nearly identical nutrition, minus most caffeine
  * Instant Coffee: May contain slightly higher sodium and trace carbs
  * Chicory Coffee: Different composition, including small amounts of carbohydrates
  * Flavored or “Mocha” Coffee: Can contain significant calories, sugar, and fat depending on added ingredients (milk, syrups, etc.)

## In a Nutshell (of Coffee Bean)

If you’re drinking black coffee, you’re getting a near-zero calorie beverage with minimal nutritional impact and small amounts of beneficial minerals.

Once you start adding cream, sugar, or flavorings, the nutrition profile changes significantly.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Executive Chairman

Evan Hafer is the founder of Black Rifle Coffee Company, and served as our CEO from inception through December 2023. He currently serves as our Executive Chairman. ## Chris Mondzelewski

Chief Executive Officer

Chris Mondzelewski has served as Chief Executive Officer since Jan of 2024. Chris comes to Black Rifle with more than 28 years of consumer marketing, business and leadership experience. For the past 13 years, he was at Mars Inc and held multiple leadership positions of increasing responsibility across the company including Chief Growth Officer, Senior VP North America Customer Development, and VP of Marketing. Prior to that, Chris spent 12 years at Kraft Foods where he led businesses in North America and China. ## Matthew Amigh

Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Amigh brings more than 25 years of financial, operational, and supply chain leadership across public and private consumer businesses and will play a key role in BRCC’s efforts to drive profitable growth and deliver long-term shareholder value.

Prior to joining BRCC, Mr. Amigh served as Chief Financial Officer of Ethos Pet Nutrition. He was previously CFO and Interim CEO of Bulletproof 360, Inc., where he led the company’s return to profitability and its eventual sale. He also held executive leadership roles at Lenny & Larry’s and Raybern Foods. While at Raybern Foods, Mr. Amigh served as both CFO and COO, overseeing a comprehensive transformation and guiding the company through a successful strategic exit. 
## Andrew McCormick

General Counsel and Corporate Secretary

Andrew McCormick joined the Company as General Counsel in September 2021. Mr. McCormick previously worked as a Senior Associate at Hogan Lovells US LLP from 2014 to 2019 and as an associate at Latham & Watkins (London), LLP from 2011 to 2013. In 2010, Mr. McCormick completed a civilian clerkship with US Army JAG in Seoul, South Korea. Mr. McCormick graduated from Hendrix College with a B.A. with distinction, and holds a J.D. from Columbia University and an LL.M. from the London School of Economics.

## Kim Evanoff

Chief Commercial Officer

Kim has led both domestic and international teams, delivering brand strategy, organizational development, and long-term growth across multiple channels and global markets. We specialize in catering and satisfying big crowds. You can order as many small, medium, or large subs as you want! You can even place a catering order. Choose to have your order made as soon as possible or for a later time.

## How will I know when my order is ready?

We are good at deadlines. When you select your day/time for pickup, we will have it ready to go at the front counter or at the “Pick-Up Zone”.

Check out our nutrition information here

View shareable side dishes.  [Button: What shareable side enhancements are available?] Enhance your Full Churrasco Experience and add a shareable side for the table. Before placing your order, please inform your Server if you or a person in your party has a food allergy or dietary restriction or visit our healthy eating page to learn more about your options prior to your visit. [Button: Do you have vegan/vegetarian/gluten-free options?] Fogo offers a wide variety of options for many dietary preferences, including vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, and gluten-free choices. The Market Table features many fresh, seasonal selections and is 100% gluten free. Please inform your Server of any dietary restriction or allergy before ordering so the team can guide your experience. [Button: Is your food halal?] Select items may be suitable for Guests seeking halal options. Fogo’s lamb is sourced from New Zealand and Australia and is halal; our Wagyu is also halal and sourced from Australia. Please note that lamb chops are typically prepared with a white wine marinade, though you may request lamb chops without that marinade. Speak with a Manager or Server about your dietary needs during each visit. [Button: Is your food kosher?] Fogo restaurants are not certified kosher. Guests with kosher dietary needs should speak with the local Manager before dining to discuss available options and preparation considerations. [Button: Do the seafood items on the menu mean your kitchen is not safe for people with seafood allergies?] Our restaurant is safe for Guests with fish/seafood allergies.  Please speak with the Manager at your nearest Fogo location on each visit regarding seafood and any other dietary needs to ensure they are accommodated. [Button: I have a Soy allergy. At other Churrascaria's there are certain items that I've found that I need to avoid. What would I need to avoid at your restaurant?] We take pride in the fact that we can accommodate many of our Guests’ dietary concerns because of the variety of choices we offer. We do recommend you speak with the Manager at your location on each visit regarding any specific dietary needs to ensure they are accommodated. The Manager can guide you to a meal suitable to your needs. To take advantage of this offer, simply present your approved WLS bariatric card and enjoy the Full Churrasco Experience at half-price. Other entrees will be available at regular prices. If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to Contact Us. [Button: Is there wheelchair access/handicap parking?] Yes. Fogo restaurants are equipped with wheelchair accessibility. If you, or someone in your party, has mobility needs, note it on your reservation or contact the restaurant so the team can help make your visit most comfortable. [Button: Can I bring my dog?] Service animals are welcome in accordance with applicable law. ## PRESIDENT AND CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Lance Trenary began his restaurant career in his father’s restaurant at a young age, where he learned the value of guests and the people who serve them. Lance joined Golden Corral in 1986 as Partner Manager. After deciding to pursue a multiunit career with Golden Corral, he quickly rose through the system, holding leadership roles of increasing responsibility. # Why isn’t there a nutritional label on the box?

July 17, 2025 14:34 Updated

Because the natural flavors are used at such low levels, they do not contribute any meaningful amounts of nutrients.  Similarly, ground coffee does not contribute significant amounts of nutrients that would require nutrition labeling.  Thus, the products, which are only composed of coffee and natural flavors, are expressly exempt from bearing nutrition labeling under FDA regulations.

### Which locations are providing the new catering menu and delivery?

All Pei Wei locations offer a Catering menu.

### What services does Pei Wei Catering offer?

We use 3rd party delivery services.

### What is your delivery fee?

The delivery fee varies based on the distance and the order value, ranging from $30 to $70.

### Does the delivery fee go to the driver?

We use 3rd party delivery companies. The fee goes directly to the 3rd party company. You are welcome to tip the driver.

### What size events does Pei Wei cater for?

From just 5 to hundreds- let us know what your needs are, and we will do our best to accommodate. Currently, we have no maximum order size but larger orders may require additional lead time.

### Does Pei Wei offer Full-Service Catering?

We are not able to send staff to stay and serve but our catering options come ready to serve.

### How do I place a Catering order?

Place your catering order at catering.peiwei.com or call your local Pei Wei and press 2 for catering.

### How much notice do you need for a Catering order?

We appreciate 24 hours’ notice and you can book as far as two weeks prior. If you have a last-minute need we will do our best to accommodate you, but keep in mind that everything is dependent on the availability of our hard-working team and made from scratch food and the volume of orders that may already be in our queue.

### Is set up included on Delivery?

No, at this time we only provide delivery.

### Do catering orders include paper supplies?

Yes, we include plates, napkins, serving and eating utensils with every order. If you do not need paper supplies let us know.

### Does Pei Wei accept checks?

At this time, we do not accept checks- check back periodically for updates. If you are a school and require billing please submit an Inquiry Form and we will do our best to accommodate you.

### Can I pay in advance?

Yes, you can. In fact, a pre-payment is required for all online orders.

### Can I set up a House Account, PO Number or be invoiced for catering orders?

### Where can I find a catering menu?

Head to catering.peiwei.com to find available catering dishes at participating stores.

### How do I request a quote?

You can email us at [email protected]. Or call your local Pei Wei and press 2 to speak to a catering specialist.

### I have vegetarians coming to my event. What are my food options?

Pei Wei has delicious options – hand-tossed vegetable medley with a choice of sauce, vegetable spring rolls, chopped Asian salad, or several wok dishes just request vegetables only. If you’re ordering one of our Catering Packages, we suggest adding a side or two of wok-style vegetables.

For Catering Packages with vegetarian options, you can add Vegetable and Tofu options in platters or as individual meals. Please note that Vegan options are not available.

### Where can I find nutritional and allergen information?

You can grab that right off our website, just click on Nutrition.

### Does Pei Wei have gluten-free options?

Yes, we do offer gluten-free options, including salads, steak, chicken, and more. For more information, please visit https://www.peiwei.com/menu/gluten-free/

## Store Information

How do I find my neighborhood store?

You can locate a store near you by using our helpful Store Locator.

What time do you open?

We bake our bagels fresh every morning, which means we’re up pretty early! Each store is different, so find your bakery’s hours by using our Store Locator.

Are you open on holidays?

Noah’s Bagels locations are closed on Christmas Day to allow our team members to spend time with their family and friends. Some Noah’s locations may be closed on additional holidays based on local store management discretion. We encourage our guests to check the store hours for their neighborhood bakery prior to visiting on holidays.

When will my bakery re-open their dining room?

While the majority of our bakeries have re-opened their dining rooms, we have decided to transition some smaller bakeries or bakeries in select locations to takeout only bakeries. You can find the status of this and other amenities for your neighborhood bakery on our locations page.

How do I request a refund?

We’re sorry your last experience with us missed the mark. To request a refund, Contact Us and complete the form. For fastest resolution, please include the order total, order date, name on the credit card used, last 4 digits of the credit card used and the expiration date along with the reason why you are requesting a refund. Our team will follow up to your request via email.

Does Noah's Bagels donate or participate in charity events & fundraisers?

All donation and charity requests are handled by your local bakery GM. Please call or visit your local bakery to determine if your donation or charity event may be a good fit.
Looking for your local bakery? Search locations.

## Nutritional Info

Where can I find nutrition, ingredient, & allergen information for Noah's Bagels menu items?

Absolutely! You can find nutrition & allergy information for both in-store & catering menus here.

If I have food allergies or other special needs, will I still be able to dine at Noah's Bagels?

Please know that we are always happy to accommodate any dietary need or food allergy the best we can; however, there is always a risk of cross-contamination in our stores.
Need more details? View full nutritional and allergen information.

Do you have any gluten free or keto-friendly bagels?

At this time, we do not have any plans to carry gluten free or keto-friendly bagels as a regular product in our stores. However, we are always working hard to find ways to improve and expand our offerings so this may change in the future. In the meantime, please check back with us for any updates as we are continuously rolling out new and exciting menu items!
View our menu to see all we have to offer today!

## Order Ahead

When can I place an Order Ahead order either online or in the app?

Guests can place online or in-app orders up to 3 days in advance and up until 15 minutes prior to the desired pick-up time. The last available time slot for order ahead pickup is 30 minutes prior to closing. Please note catering orders can be placed several weeks in advance through our dedicated catering ordering site.

Check your bakery’s operating hours on our locations page.

Can I use a coupon when placing an order online or in the app?

Great news, you can now apply coupons directly in the app and when placing online orders. Enter the promo code at checkout and enjoy the savings while you continue to own the morning.

Love bagels and bonuses? Learn more about and sign up for Noah’s. Rewards today!

Can I use a gift card for my online or app order?

You sure can! Rewards members may transfer their complete gift card balance to their rewards account wallet to be used on orders placed via our app or online ordering. If you need to make a change or cancel, please reach out to our Guest Services team, selecting ‘Refund Request’ for the original order. Next, if necessary, place a new order with the changes needed.

For catering orders, please contact CateringSupport@bagelbrands.com.

When can I place an Order Ahead order either online or in the app?

We currently accept same-day orders both online and in our app from the time the bakery opens to 30 minutes prior to closing. Please note all order ahead orders need to be picked up prior to the bakery closing time.
Check your bakery’s operating hours on our locations page.

Can I use a coupon when placing an order online or in the app?

Currently we are unable to accept coupons in the app or online. Please visit a bakery to use your offer in store.
Looking for your closest bakery? Visit our locations page.

Can I use a gift card for my online or app order?

To use a gift card when ordering ahead on either the Noah’s app or online, you will need to Contact Us so we can load your gift card’s value to your Rewards Account. Please be sure to include the full gift card number & the email or phone number associated with your Rewards account to facilitate a quick turnaround of your request.
If you do not have a Rewards Account, there is not currently a way to pay for your order online or in the app with a gift card at this time. Please note that we continue to work on ways to streamline the order ahead app & online experience.

Does Noah's Bagels offer delivery?

Yes! We deliver through partners including Doordash, Uber Eats, and GrubHub. Please note delivery options may very by market.
Looking for catering delivery? We offer that too for orders over $25. View Catering Menu

The password requires at least 8 characters and you must use at least one numeric and one capital letter.
Still need help? Contact us.

I requested my password to be reset but I never got the reset password email.

Please check your spam or junk folder for the email. The email will have a subject line of “Password Reset Request” and will come from Customer Relations (the sender email address is guest@paytronix.com).

I recently moved and have updated my city/state/zip code but now I am no longer receiving emails, what happened?

Log into your account to update your account information. Depending on where you live, the location in your area may or may not participate in the Noah’s Rewards program. As such, you may not get emails from us featuring reward information or deals which are not available in your area. You may still receive information about other news happening, such as new menu items and more!

When do reward points expire?

Your reward points stick around for six months after your last order. But here’s the good news—every time you place an order, that six-month timer resets. So keep the bagels coming and your points will keep piling up!

## Coupons & Offers

How can I get coupons or special offers?

The best way to receive the latest promotions and coupons for Noah’s Bagels is by signing up for Noah’s Rewards, our loyalty program. As a rewards member, you will earn points on every order to redeem for your favorite bagels, breakfast sandwiches and more. You will also receive special reward member only discounts as well as surprise & delight offers!
Interested? Sign Up Today!

Do you accept coupons on smartphones?

You bet! Our coupons displayed on your smartphone will gladly be accepted in-bakery at any participating location, so long as the coupon is valid. Looking to use your coupon via our app or when placing an order online? Enter the promo code at checkout. Please note, some offers may available in-bakery or via digital channels only.

Be sure you always have the latest offers & deals by joining Noah’s Rewards. Sign up Today!

Do you have any senior or military discounts?

Select locations may participate in senior or military discounts. Please note this discount is only available in-bakery and is offered at the discretion of our local store management teams.

## Catering

How do I order catering?

The fastest and easiest way to place your order is online. You can choose from our delicious fresh menu items, set pick up or delivery times and process your payment. All orders placed after 3:00pm will be available for pick-up or delivery after 7:30am the next day.

How do I get a copy of the catering menu?

Our online menu is always the most up to date.
Need to print? Download a PDF of our catering menu

Do you offer delivery for catering orders?

Yes, we do! Delivery is available in most areas. To check on availability in your area, enter your zip code in the order details page and choose delivery.

Do you have an order minimum for delivery?

Yes. To be eligible for delivery, the order total must be $25 before taxes, discounts and delivery fees.

What is your delivery fee for catering orders?

$19.00** for orders up to $380 or 5% of the order amount on any order over $380. **Delivery fees may vary by location.

Can I order catering from my favorite store?

Yes! We understand many of our guests have long time relationships with their local store and want you to continue with them! Once you are logged in, go to “My Preferred Store” section to choose your favorite store. Or you can email us at CateringSupport@bagelbrands.com and have a catering specialist select your store for you.

How late can I place my catering order?

Same day online catering orders must be placed at least 4 hours in advance of delivery or pickup. To ensure we serve you the best quality product and meet our Fresh Baked Policy, we are unable to accommodate early morning orders for next day service once our bakeries have closed. We are happy to serve you but will need additional time to have your order prepared; therefore all “next day” orders placed after 3:00pm will be available for pick-up or delivery after 7:30am the following day.


During select times of the year we do offer promotional programs or discounts on our Gift Cards. To stay in the know on gift card and other promotions, be sure to sign up for Noah’s Rewards and opt-into email or app push notifications on your mobile device.

Are there any fees associated with Noah's Bagels Gift Cards?

No. There are no fees associated with Gift Cards. You will only be charged the face value of the Gift Card and shipping if applicable. eGift Cards are sent via email and incur no shipping charges.

Can I reload my Gift Card after I've spent the full value?

Not at this time.

Need another gift card? Shop gift cards

Can I get a refund on my gift card?

Cards may not be redeemed for cash and no refunds or change will be given unless required by law. However, non-promotional cards under $10 are refundable in participating stores in CA; non-promotional cards under $5 are refundable in participating stores in CO, ME, MA, MT, NJ, OR, and WA; non-promotional cards under $2.50 are refundable in participating stores in TX; and, non-promotional cards under $1 are refundable in participating stores in VT and RI.

Can I change the value of a Gift Card after I've paid for it?

Not at this time.
If your gift card has not been delivered or shipped, you can cancel the order by contacting Customer Support.

What do I do if my gift card has no balance or is not swiping at the register?

We are so sorry to hear this! We are happy to look into things for you. Please contact us by filling out our contact form and we will get back to you via email.

What if I lose my Gift Card?

Your Gift Card has cash value and should be safeguarded as such. If you lose your Gift Card, contact Customer Support immediately with the gift card number from the back of the card or from the email for eGift Cards. If your Gift Card has not been redeemed or has some remaining value, we can cancel the original and issue you a new eGift Card for that value.
For physical gift cards, contact us. For eGift Card support, contact our eGift Card partners at CashStar.
